Refund Policy

Hassle-Free Refunds – Your Satisfaction Matters

Jadubot Refund Policy

At Jadubot, customer satisfaction is our priority. We aim to provide high-quality AI chatbot solutions for businesses of all sizes. If you are not fully satisfied with your purchase, we offer a fair refund policy to ensure a hassle-free experience.

Refund Eligibility

We offer refunds under the following conditions:

  • If you experience a technical issue that we cannot resolve within 7 days of your request.

  • If the service you purchased is not delivered as described on our website.

  • If you cancel your subscription within 3 days of the initial purchase and have not used the service extensively.

Non-Refundable Cases

Refunds are not available in these situations:

  • If you change your mind after purchasing.

  • If you have already used our service and benefited from it.

  • If your refund request is beyond the eligible time frame.

  • If your account is suspended due to policy violations.

How to Request a Refund

To request a refund, follow these steps:

  1. Contact our support team at support@jadubot.com.

  2. Provide your order details and the reason for the refund request.

  3. Our team will review your request and respond within 3-5 business days.

Refund Processing Time

  • Approved refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days.

  • The amount will be credited back to your original payment method.

  • Processing times may vary based on your bank or payment provider.

Need Help?

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our support team at support@jadubot.com. We’re always here to help!

Can Jadubot work for small businesses?


Absolutely! Jadubot is designed for businesses of all sizes. Whether you’re a startup or an established brand, our tools will help you save time, connect with customers, and grow your business.

How does the free trial work?


You can enjoy Jadubot’s premium features free for 14 days—no commitment required. Explore its functionalities and see how it transforms your business before deciding to subscribe.
